message: 機関者トーナス
When I stepped into the Shiokumi Shopping District, the area was filled with the crisp sound of frying, delicious smells, and everyone's lively chatter.

name: Sally
message: 「Sizzle~, sizz-sizzle~♪ Karaage, tempura~♪」

name: Eauderourke
message: 「Tempura, hard. Beef bowl, easy」

name: Shina-oba
message: 「Nah, it's just a matter of getting used to it. These pumpkins aren't for sale anyway, so if you can fry 'em up that well, you're doing great, Ode-yan」

name: Sally
message: 「Sniff, sniff, sniff, looks delicious~\s07」
A heartwarming scene surrounding the street stalls set up along the main road.

name: Synn
message: 「Oh, right, today is--」
The Halloween after-party. That's what I've taken to calling it on my own.
The shopkeepers bring together their leftover pumpkins to make fried dishes, stews, and steamed buns, and hand them out for free to passersby.
If you hoard them away carefully, the pumpkins will just go bad. So they have the customers eat them before that happens.
It looks like Sally-chan and Eauderourke are also participating this year in this modest event spearheaded by Auntie Shinagawa.

name: Tame-san
message: 「Yo, Synn! I figured you'd be showing up right about now」

name: Tame-san
message: 「Hahaha, these sweet-and-savory fried pumpkins go great with beer, let me tell ya!」

name: Sally
message: 「Tame-san, you smell like booze~」

name: Tame-san
message: 「Don't sweat it!」

name: Shina-oba
message: 「What's there not to sweat? Honestly, getting all drunk in the middle of the day」

name: Sally
message: 「Munch munch, chomp chomp. Phew~, the pumpkin's yummy~」

name: Synn
message: 「Ahahaha, things are lively again this time」

name: Kim-san
message: 「All thanks to everyone, ne. I made sure to set aside a portion for you too, Synn-kun, aru yo」
I accept a paper bag from the Five-Star Restaurant packed tightly with fried pumpkin.

name: Synn
message: 「Thank you!」

name: Kim-san
message: 「Ode-kun was the one who made it, ne」

name: Eauderourke
message: 「Ode, make」

name: Sally
message: 「Nom nom, munch munch. Hehehe-hee~♪」

name: Kim-san
message: 「Sally-chan, all you do is eat, ne」

name: Shina-oba
message: 「This girl really makes her food look delicious when she eats. Makes her a great draw for customers」

name: Tame-san
message: 「...Oh? Uh-oh, the wind's picking up」
Sobering up in an instant, Tame-san looks up at the sky.
The sunlight dims slightly, and a damp sea breeze blows through the shopping district street.

name: Tame-san
message: 「Uh-oh, this looks bad... A sudden evening shower's coming.」

name: Shina-oba
message: 「Well then, it's a little early, but let's call it a day for this year. We'll just give away the leftovers as freebies at everyone's storefronts.」

name: Kim-san
message: 「Comin' right up!」
Working in seamless sync, the shopping district folks pack up the stalls in the blink of an eye.
With Eauderourke around to handle the heavy lifting, the teardown goes even more smoothly.

name: Sally
message: 「Prez, I borrowed an umbrella!」

name: Sally
message: 「Let's take that yummy pumpkin stuff over to that pale, flat-chested girl!」

name: Synn
message: 「Azel?」

name: Sally
message: 「Pfft, I didn't even say a name and you already jumped to conclusions!」

name: Synn
message: 「Th-Then who are you talking about?」

name: Sally
message: 「Obviously it's Azel!」

name: Sally
message: 「Isn't she always so sullen 'cause she's hungry? If she eats pumpkin, she'll turn out just like Nanaka!」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah, that's a nice idea. If we bring it to her, I'm sure she'll be happy.」

name: Sally
message: 「Yessir! So, where is Azel anyway?」

name: Synn
message: 「U-Umm...」
With the fried pumpkin in one hand, I take Sally-chan along and head off to look for Azel.
Luckily, the evening shower stopped right away. However, aside from the rain, there was another problem...
Along the way, Sally-chan couldn't hold back and started crunching away on the fried pumpkin. She made it look so delicious that I ended up eating some too.
When we had eaten about half of it, we finally spotted Azel.
What a predicament... How am I supposed to explain handing over the remaining half of the fried pumpkin? It was a fun little puzzle to mull over.
